claim_boundary: This boundary records representative-benchmark portfolio readiness criteria tied to the bounded static portfolio map. It does not claim a domain-coverage matrix, benchmark admission checklist, repeated-seed run matrix, anti-gaming certification, SOTA/baseline citation sufficiency, portfolio-balance CI freshness, or owner review signoff.

readiness_criteria.current_scope: five static portfolio families with domain labels
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: domain-coverage matrix proving the portfolio is balanced across algorithm, math, systems, and smoke-guardrail surfaces
readiness_criteria.portfolio_surface: benchmark families, domains, validators, and AlphaEvolve claim scope

active_todo_refs.required_phrase: separating smoke fixtures, benchmark candidates, and paper-comparable

readiness_criteria.current_scope: static family readiness labels plus smoke-fixture guardrail
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: admission checklist that prevents smoke fixtures from counting as representative benchmark coverage
readiness_criteria.portfolio_surface: candidate fixtures, smoke examples, benchmark candidates, and paper-comparable evidence
readiness_criteria.validation_gate: benchmark admission checklist with smoke exclusion

active_todo_refs.required_phrase: repeated-seed evidence and exact binomial diagnostics

readiness_criteria.current_scope: sidecars for repeated sampling and sample efficiency without per-family run matrix
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: per-family repeated-seed matrix with target-hit, confidence, and run-budget evidence
readiness_criteria.portfolio_surface: repeated-seed runs, sample-efficiency claims, and benchmark certification

active_todo_refs.required_phrase: Connect benchmark-grade fixtures to hardening and scope reports.

readiness_criteria.current_scope: validator and audit sidecars without benchmark-level anti-gaming certification
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: anti-gaming certification proving fixtures resist benchmark-specific hacks and evaluator leakage
readiness_criteria.portfolio_surface: validators, evaluator oracles, incorrect suggestions, and hardening reports

active_todo_refs.required_phrase: benchmark harness for repeated seeds, SOTA thresholds

readiness_criteria.current_scope: baseline/SOTA target labels on each portfolio family
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: citation sufficiency proof for every target baseline and benchmark threshold
readiness_criteria.portfolio_surface: baseline/SOTA targets, paper citations, and benchmark target thresholds

active_todo_refs.required_phrase: CI freshness gate, or owner signoff

readiness_criteria.current_scope: static portfolio family map without balance scoring or freshness enforcement
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: portfolio-balance score and CI freshness gate with owner-reviewed readiness signoff
readiness_criteria.portfolio_surface: portfolio balance score, stale coverage detection, CI freshness, and owner signoff
readiness_criteria.validation_gate: portfolio balance and CI freshness gate
